biggest_catch: The $50 only lands after a 90-day qualification window - the friend must complete the checking or loan path within 90 days of joining, and payouts are processed no sooner than 90 days after membership opening.
catches: Friend must be new to Premier (no current or prior membership, including as joint owner/co-borrower in the last 12 months); referral must be identified at account opening - no retroactive referrals.

Friend completes ONE path within 90 days: checking (open qualifying personal checking + Digital Banking/eStatements + two direct deposits of $250+) OR loan (approved and funded qualifying loan of $10,000+ + Digital Banking/eStatements).
Payouts processed no sooner than 90 days after membership open; if not qualified within 90 days, no payout.
Both referrer and new member must be 18+ and in good standing at payout; one may still be paid if the other is ineligible.
Cap: total referral payouts capped at $599.99 per member per calendar year (combined referrer/new-member payouts); may be reported to IRS.
Employees and board members ineligible; minimum $5 share account required; cannot be combined with other checking/loan offers.
